subject: URGENT: PayGet Direct Deposit Suspended - Action Needed Now
body:
From: Payroll Support <payget-verify99@mail-alerts-center.com>

Dear Employee,

Your PayGet direct deposit account has been flagged and suspended. You MUST verify your payroll profile within 1 hour or your upcoming paycheck will be permanently cancelled!!

Click here right away: [Update Payroll Details](http://198.51.100.77/payget-login)

Thank you,
Payroll Dept

From: IT Helpdesk <+44-7700-900412>

URGENT: Your Microsoft 365 password expires in 30 minutes and your hospital account will be locked. Reply to this text with your username and current password, or log in immediately at [Verify M365 Account](http://192.0.2.88/m365/login.php) to avoid suspension.

subject: Employee Wellness: November Cafeteria Menu & Yoga Schedule
body:

Hi David,

subject: Planned Weekend Maintenance: Staff Portal (Sunday 2:00 AM - 4:00 AM)
body:
From: IT Operations <it-ops@fozermemorial.org>

Hi Rachel,

IT Operations will perform scheduled server maintenance this Sunday from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM. During this window, the staff portal may be briefly unavailable, though clinical inpatient workstations and Microsoft 365 email will remain online.

No action is required on your part. You can check live system status anytime at [Staff Portal Status Page](https://portal.fozermemorial.org/status).

Thank you,
IT Operations

From: Fozer Facilities <facilities@fozermemorial.org>

Hi Jordan, this is a friendly reminder from Facilities that the East Lot employee shuttle is running every 10 minutes today due to repaving on Main Street. Thank you for your patience.

subject: PayGet Notification: Your Biweekly Earnings Statement Is Ready
body:
From: Payroll Department <payroll@fozermemorial.org>

Hi Kevin,

Your biweekly earnings statement for the November 1-14 pay period is now available in PayGet.

To view your pay stub, please sign in through the official staff portal as usual: [https://portal.fozermemorial.org/payget](https://portal.fozermemorial.org/payget)

As a reminder, Payroll will never ask for your password, PIN, or banking details via email.

Sincerely,
Billing & Payroll Services

subject: Annual HIPAA Privacy & Microsoft 365 Security Refresher
body:
From: Compliance & HR <compliance@fozermemorial.org>

Hi Dr. Alvarez,

Our training records indicate that your annual HIPAA Privacy and Microsoft 365 Security Refresher module is scheduled for completion by November 30.

When your schedule permits, please navigate to the learning module through the hospital portal: [Annual Compliance Portal](https://portal.fozermemorial.org/learning/hipaa-2026).

If you completed this module within the past 48 hours, please disregard this notice while records finish syncing.

Thank you,
Office of Compliance & Human Resources
